thread:
sarah_support: FYI customer-prod-42 reports repeated 5xx timeouts during a large tenant burst ~11:10 PST. They saw 30-60s end-to-end, lots of gateway 504s. Trace ids: trace=tx-8f3a, tx-8f3b.
jamal_sre: Can you paste a sample request/trace and the gateway logs? Was this a single region?
sarah_support: Region us-west-2. Customer attached curl + trace header: `curl -H \"x-request-id:tx-8f3a\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` -> gateway 504. Gateway log shows upstream timeout: `upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out)`.
alex_infra: Looking at metrics, we saw a big spike in queue_depth for tenant prod-42 and scaledobject for the model pool didn't spin up fast enough. KEDA scaledobject shows `cooldownPeriod: 300` and `minReplicaCount: 0`.
maria_ops: Oof. minReplicaCount=0 + long cooldown means coldstart on burst. Also readiness probe is `initialDelaySeconds: 10, periodSeconds: 10, timeoutSeconds: 5` which might fail while model downloads.
leo_eng: Confirmed model init for that variant takes ~18s on p4d when cache miss. Combined with container start + preflight (~12s) pushes past request deadline.
jamal_sre: Any recent config changes to HPA or KEDA for that pool?
alex_infra: We deployed a KEDA tweak yesterday to lower metric thresholds; unintentionally increased cooldown from 60->300 in the same helm values file. Might be the culprit.
sarah_support: Customer escalated to CS and is worried about SLA breaches. They also mentioned auth errors 403 intermittently — could be requests retried while backend is recovering.
cs_bot: Noted customer-prod-42 severity=P1. Assigned to oncall.
jamal_sre: Repro steps: 1) Hammer a new tenant slot to push queue_depth above threshold. 2) Observe keda scaledobject events and HPA metrics. 3) Watch for readiness failures and gateway 504s.
alex_infra: Quick mitigation: bump `minReplicaCount` to 1 for that model pool and reduce `cooldownPeriod` to 90. Also lower gateway upstream timeout to 60s temporarily to allow graceful responses.
maria_ops: Rolling a targeted change to keda values for prod-42 pool now (helm patch). Will route through canary.
leo_eng: Also propose adding a pre-warm hook: keep a tiny warm cache (lightweight instance with quantized model) to absorb initial burst then handoff. Longer-term we can add cached KV prefix warming per tenant.
jamal_sre: For triage we need logs: `kubectl -n inference get scaledobject -l pool=prod-42 -o yaml` and `kubectl -n inference logs deploy/gw --since=15m | grep tx-8f3a`. Can someone paste outputs?
alex_infra: Pasting scaledobject events snippet: `ScaledObject scaledobject-prod-42 responded to metric queue_length, triggers: scale up to 5 replicas, but cooldown prevented scale from 0->1 until 3m elapsed` (events trimmed).
sarah_support: Customer provided example of retry storms in client: their SDK retries on 5xx, which magnified the spike. I asked them to temporarily disable aggressive retries.
jamal_sre: Action items: 1) Apply emergency helm patch (minReplicaCount=1, cooldown=90) ✅ 2) Increase readiness timeout to 60s while model init stabilizes ✅ 3) Monitor queue_depth and 5xx rate for 30m. 4) Follow up with product on pre-warm plan.
maria_ops: Patch applied to canary pool at 11:28 PST. Observing reduced queue and no new 504s for canary traffic. Rolling to full pool now.
leo_eng: Pushed a fast fallback: route to smaller quantized model if warm instances unavailable (feature flag). Enabled for prod-42.
sarah_support: Customer confirmed errors dropped after ~11:35 and will hold on SLA claims for now. They still want a postmortem explaining root cause and steps to prevent recurrence.
jamal_sre: Root cause summary draft: KEDA minReplicaCount=0 + accidental cooldown increase -> scale-up delay during sudden tenant burst. Combined with long model init and aggressive client retries produced transient 5xx and gateway timeouts.
alex_infra: Next steps for infra: add guardrail to avoid cooldown > 180 for pools with minReplicaCount=0, add telemetry alert when scaledobject events show \"scale intent\" but replicas remain 0 for > 60s.
maria_ops: Also propose a per-tenant pre-warm policy when an enterprise burst pattern is detected (predictive scaling).
sarah_support: I'll file the customer-facing summary and coordinate postmortem with eng+infra.
deploy-bot: Deployment success: helm release prod-42-keda patched at 11:31 PST.
cs_bot: Logged CS follow-up meeting for 13:00 PST.
jamal_sre: Leaving this thread open until 12:05 to confirm stability. If no regression, mark resolved. :white_check_mark:
